convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load a non-standard indicator 'Modified_Optimum_Elliptic_Filter' and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position management, requiring manual recreation of both the custom indicator logic and the trading utility functions.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before trading

other_exits: Opposite signal closes position: long filter turning down triggers BuyPosClose=true, short filter turning up triggers SellPosClose=true, both gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode input selects between LOT (fixed lots) and MARGIN (deposit fraction) modes via MarginMode enum from TradeAlgorithms.mqh. MM=0.1 is either 0.1 lots or 10% margin depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: The entry signal uses a 3-bar read from the custom indicator buffer at offset SignalBar (default=1). The trend direction is determined by Value[1] vs Value[2]: if filter is declining (Value[1]<Value[2]), a rise in the most recent bar (Value[0]>Value[1]) triggers a buy signal. Conversely if filter is rising (Value[1]>Value[2]), a decline (Value[0]<Value[1]) triggers a sell signal. Signal is evaluated once per new bar (or on bar 0 if SignalBar==0). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans act as independent gates for each trade action. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are passed to position open functions, likely used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh for new-bar validation or slippage control. Recount flag triggers recalculation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: The custom indicator 'Modified_Optimum_Elliptic_Filter' must be reimplemented in Python (likely a digital signal processing elliptic filter). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) must be reimplemented - they encapsulate position management, new-bar detection, and history loading. The MMMode enum (LOT vs MARGIN) controls position sizing mode. Signal bar offset (SignalBar=1) means signals are read from the previous completed bar, avoiding repainting. The crossover logic is non-standard: it checks if the overall filter trend (Value[1] vs Value[2]) combined with a short-term reversal (Value[0] vs Value[1]) to generate signals.
